::: typewriter
Typed at the London office. Location: Kessler & Daughters toy works, Wickfold. On air 15:00 to 16:15.

Crew: R. Platt, producer and presenter. F. Okafor, camera 1. L. Hobbs, camera 2 and sound.

- 14:00: crew call in the factory yard.
- 14:45: camera 1 in the packing hall, by the speaking tube. Camera 2 in the yard, on the tower dial.
- 15:00: on air. R. Platt opens in the yard.
- 15:10 to 15:25: R. Platt alone in the clock room. No crew.
- 15:17: the clock stops again, live on camera.
- 15:30: R. Platt meets Mrs Kessler in the packing hall.
- 16:00: camera 1 on the workers in the halls. Hold the shot.
- 16:15: off air. Drinks at the Swan.
  :::

::: handwriting
If the four o'clock whistle stays silent live on air, and the robots miss their train, every newspaper in the country will write about us.
:::
